title: Q1 2026 Perf Baseline — Model Matrix (v0.7)
content:
Last updated: 2026-02-14 (Arjun)

Purpose
- Single source for which models/variants are in the Q1’26 baseline suite, with the exact contexts + quant profiles, and where/how they must be run.
- Used by: benchmark-lab runner configs, perf-canary nightly, release qualification checklist.

Legend
- Priority: P0 (must-run for baseline lock + gating), P1 (should-run weekly + for RC), P2 (coverage/diagnostic), P3 (optional/adhoc)
- Deploy mode tags: Hosted=H, Dedicated=D, Private=P (baseline suite is shared; perf numbers may be published only after PM approval)
- Regions are baseline regions (not all production regions). Fleet normalization owner: Vanessa.

Standard hardware pools (baseline)
- H100-SXM-80GB: primary perf reference (Hosted + Dedicated)
- H100-PCIe-80GB: secondary (Dedicated / some regions)
- A100-80GB: compatibility + older fleet reference
- L40S-48GB: cost-oriented / smaller models + embeddings

Baseline regions (Q1)
- us-east-1 (primary)
- us-west-2
- eu-west-1

Traffic-shape mapping (IDs referenced above)
- S1: interactive chat, short prompts (p50 200 tok), short outputs (p50 150), non-stream; concurrency 16–64; cache warm
- S2: interactive chat, mixed prompts (p50 800 / p95 3k), streaming; concurrency 32–128; cache warm
- S3: long-context summarize, heavy prefill (8k–24k prompt), non-stream; concurrency 4–16; cold->warm phases
- S4: bursty tenant mix (spiky arrivals), streaming; concurrency ramps 32->256; tests queue/backpressure
- S5: low-latency single-tenant (dedicated-like), non-stream; concurrency 8–32; low batching pressure
- S6: mixed-tenant fairness (two tenants: small + large prompts), streaming; tests scheduler fairness + tail latency
- E1: embeddings steady-state batching; concurrency 64–512; verifies token counters + throughput
- E2: embeddings burst + cache effects (if applicable)
- R1: rerank short sequences, latency sensitivity; concurrency 32–128

Required baseline outputs (per row)
- TTFT p50/p95/p99 (streaming: server-side TTFT + client-validated TTFT where available)
- TPOT p50/p95/p99
- End-to-end latency (non-stream): p50/p95/p99
- Throughput: req/s and tok/s (prefill vs decode split)
- Error rate + load-shed counts
- Scheduler explainability metrics enabled (queue wait, batch composition, backpressure counters)

Open items / to decide (tracked in comments in the sheet previously)
- Whether M-004 Mixtral should be P0 for scheduler changes touching MoE routing (Sofia wants P0; Sean prefers P1 due to variance).
- Final publishable subset (PM-612): candidate is M-001/M-003 TTFT/TPOT bands on H100-SXM in us-east-1 only, with strict footnotes.
- A100 baseline refresh policy when driver/CUDA shifts (see INT-1440).

Notes for runner configuration
- Every baseline run must stamp: runtime git SHA, benchmark-lab SHA, CUDA/driver, NCCL, kernel autotune seed, region, instance type, and fleet pool ID.
- For P0 rows, only run on pinned fleets (Vanessa to provide pool IDs) and block on environment drift.
